name: log-crash-search
title: Data & Analytics > Log & Crash Search > Log Collection

operations.name: send-log
operations.summary: Send one log to the collection server (max 8MB per log; projectName is the appkey; custom, txt*, long* and double* fields go in --body)

fields.name: host
fields.description: Address of the sending device (default: peer address)

fields.name: sendTime
fields.description: Time sent by the device, Unix timestamp

fields.name: UserBinaryData
fields.description: Base64-encoded data shown as a download/view link

fields.name: UserTxtData
fields.description: Base64-encoded data shown as a download/view link

operations.name: send-logs-bulk
operations.summary: Send logs in bulk as a JSON array from --data-file (max 52MB per request; add lncBulkIndex per log to keep order)
